description: Check a pump.fun coin by its mint (the contract address, CA): who launched it and the deployer's record at the launch (launches before it, graduations, the gap to the previous one, launches in the last day), the bundle at creation (buyers in the first 10 s and the share of supply they took), the insiders' share now, whether one or one or two wallets bought the whole curve as it launched (bundle_at_creation.top_buyer and top_buyer_share say whether one wallet took it) (curve_bought_at_launch, with the share they still hold), curve progress, the market cap now and the real SOL behind it (sol_reserve_now), its holder count, its 20 biggest wallets now (top_holders), the 20 that made the most SOL on it with their classes (top_traders, coins launched since the tables' build), and how launches that looked the same at this age went over their next 24 h (graduation share, peak and close quantiles, how many died). For: check this coin, a rug check, is this coin bundled, who holds it, who made money on it, who deployed this token, is this dev legit. Facts, no verdict. $0.005 a call, USDC on Solana over x402, or a free key.

payment.description: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value for this exact call (USDC on Solana). Leave it out to get the offer: the price, the payee and the network come back as the error content and as _meta['payment-required'].
